opening.argument: The video presents a practical walkthrough for setting up Oracle support access and submitting a Cloud service request. Its stated scope is clear: “How to setup an Oracle Support account & Cloud Support account,” link that support account to an Oracle Cloud account, and create a service request. The screens reinforce that purpose, showing navigation to support.oracle.com, an Oracle account creation form, a Request Access step for adding a CSI, and a Cloud Support form with problem type, summary, and detailed-description fields. This is ordinary operational guidance for obtaining support through an Oracle Cloud account, consistent with technical and non-technical service use rather than a deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: In this video we walk though: - How to setup an Oracle Support account & Cloud Support account. - How to link a support account to Oracle Cloud Account. - How to create a Service Request (SR).
